description: Corrects a participant's details before the signature request is activated. Requires: signature_participant_create → participantId, signature_request_create → requestId, case_file_create → caseFileId. Any of groupId, firstName, lastName, email, phonePrefix and phoneNumber may be sent. The role CANNOT be changed, so to turn a signatory into an observer, delete it and create it again. Use this to repair a bounced or mistyped email — signature_participant_list reports emailBounced and validationError. Returns no body; confirm with signature_participant_list.
name: signature_participant_update
